identity.name: Cloud Posture Misconfiguration Sweep — Cortex Cloud CSPM (T1530 / T1078.004 / T1098)
identity.summary: Cortex Cloud CSPM scans an AWS account seeded by the cspm IaC module and surfaces nine planted misconfigurations: public S3, unversioned bucket, no-KMS bucket, SSH-open SG, DB-ports-open SG, IAM AdministratorAccess role, IAM iam:* user, unencrypted EBS, weak CloudTrail. Validates each surfaces in cortex_cloud_posture within one scan cycle, tagged CortexSimCSPMFinding.
identity.description: Cloud Security Posture Management is the static, configuration-state half of cloud defense: rather than detonating an attack, it enumerates the cloud control plane and flags resources whose configuration violates policy or compliance baselines (CIS AWS Foundations, AWS Foundational Security Best Practices, PCI-DSS). This scenario plants a curated set of nine real misconfigurations via the cspm Terraform module — each one a finding observed constantly in the wild — then validates that Cortex Cloud CSPM discovers and classifies all of them in a single scan cycle. The findings span the three highest-leverage misconfiguration classes: data exposure (public-read S3, versioning/encryption gaps that map to T1530 Data from Cloud Storage), network exposure (security groups opening SSH and database ports to 0.0.0.0/0, the precondition for T1078.004 Valid-Accounts compromise of internet-reachable services), and identity over-permission (an IAM role with AdministratorAccess and an IAM user with an inline iam:* wildcard policy, the latent T1098 Account-Manipulation / privilege-escalation surface). Detection is posture-oriented: validation XQL runs against the cortex_cloud_posture inventory dataset and the cloud_audit_logs control-plane dataset mirrored into XSIAM, asserting each planted CortexSimCSPMFinding tag appears with its finding class and severity. Two BIOCs cover the runtime-exploitable edge of the static posture — an inbound connection landing on the world-open SSH/DB security groups, and use of the over-privileged IAM principal — so the same fixture proves both CSPM (config state) and CDR/ITDR (active exploitation) coverage. A correlation rule fuses the per-class posture signals into one cloud-posture coverage incident a DC can show in the executive readout.

actors.name: Opportunistic cloud credential abusers (TeamTNT, Scarlet Eel, automated scanners)

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-CSPM-001 — Prowler/ScoutSuite posture scan + Cortex Cloud CSPM finding reconciliation

prerequisites.description: Cortex Cloud CSPM enabled and connected (read-only) to the target AWS account.
cspm IaC module applied so the nine misconfiguration fixtures are planted in the account.
An AWS profile named cortexsim-lab with read-only/audit (SecurityAudit) permissions is configured for Prowler/ScoutSuite to scan against.

payload.code:
# Posture validation — no detonation. Run a read-only CSPM scan and reconcile
# the planted CortexSimCSPMFinding tags against Cortex Cloud's posture findings.
set -euo pipefail
prowler aws --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-cortexsim-lab}" --output-formats json-ocsf --output-directory /tmp/prowler-cortexsim || true
curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CORTEX_CLOUD_API_TOKEN}" -H "Accept: application/json" \
  "${CORTEX_CLOUD_API_BASE}/posture/findings?tag=CortexSimCSPMFinding" | jq '.findings | length'

input_variables.name: AWS_PROFILE
input_variables.description: Named AWS CLI profile with read-only audit permissions for Prowler/ScoutSuite.

expected_artifacts.description: Read-only posture enumeration of S3, IAM, EC2/SG, EBS, and CloudTrail (Get*/List*/Describe*) from the scanner principal.
Each planted misconfiguration surfaces as a CSPM finding tagged CortexSimCSPMFinding.

cleanup.code: rm -rf /tmp/prowler-cortexsim; rm -f /tmp/cspm-planted.json /tmp/cspm-discovered.json; echo '[CortexSim] SIM-CSPM-001 cleanup complete — planted AWS resources owned by terraform destroy.'

biocs.name: Inbound Connection Accepted on World-Open SSH/DB Security Group
biocs.description: An inbound network connection from a public source IP is accepted against a host whose security group exposes SSH (22) or a database port (3306/5432/6379) to 0.0.0.0/0. The world-open SG is the static CSPM finding; this BIOC fires when that exposure is actually reached, bridging CSPM into CDR/NDR runtime detection.
biocs.logic:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and event_source = "vpc-flow"
| filter flow_direction = "ingress" and flow_action = "ACCEPT"
| filter dst_port in (22, 3306, 5432, 6379)
| filter not incidr(src_ip, "10.0.0.0/8") and not incidr(src_ip, "172.16.0.0/12") and not incidr(src_ip, "192.168.0.0/16")
| join type=inner (
    dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
    | filter resource_type = "aws_security_group"
    | filter tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding"
    | filter finding_class in ("ssh-open-to-world", "database-port-open-to-world")
  ) as sg on dst_security_group_id = sg.resource_id

biocs.name: Over-Privileged CSPM IAM Principal Used for Control-Plane Action
biocs.description: The IAM principal that CSPM flagged as over-privileged (AdministratorAccess role or iam:* wildcard user) performs a sensitive control-plane action (IAM mutation, key creation, policy attach). Confirms the latent privilege-escalation finding is exercisable, stitching CSPM posture to ITDR runtime identity abuse.
biocs.logic:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and event_source = "iam.amazonaws.com"
| filter event_name in ("CreateAccessKey", "AttachRolePolicy", "AttachUserPolicy", "PutUserPolicy", "CreateUser", "UpdateAssumeRolePolicy")
| join type=inner (
    dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
    | filter resource_type in ("aws_iam_role", "aws_iam_user")
    | filter tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding"
    | filter finding_class in ("role-with-admin-access", "user-with-wildcard-iam")
  ) as flagged on user_identity.arn = flagged.resource_arn

xql_queries.name: CSPM-001 Ground Truth Planted-Finding Manifest Capture
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and event_name in ("GetResources", "DescribeSecurityGroups", "ListBuckets", "ListRoles", "ListUsers", "DescribeVolumes", "DescribeTrails")
| filter resource_tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding"
| comp count() as observed by resource_type, resource_tags
| fields resource_type, resource_tags, observed

xql_queries.name: CSPM-001 S3 Data-Exposure Findings Surfaced
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and resource_type = "aws_s3_bucket"
| filter tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding"
| filter finding_class in ("public-read-bucket", "versioning-disabled", "no-customer-managed-kms")
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as buckets_flagged by finding_class
| filter buckets_flagged >= 1
| fields finding_class, buckets_flagged

xql_queries.name: CSPM-001 Network-Exposure Security-Group Findings Surfaced
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and resource_type = "aws_security_group"
| filter tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding"
| filter finding_class in ("ssh-open-to-world", "database-port-open-to-world")
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as sgs_flagged by finding_class
| filter sgs_flagged >= 1
| fields finding_class, sgs_flagged

xql_queries.name: CSPM-001 IAM Over-Permission Findings Surfaced
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and resource_type in ("aws_iam_role", "aws_iam_user")
| filter tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding"
| filter finding_class in ("role-with-admin-access", "user-with-wildcard-iam")
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as principals_flagged by finding_class
| filter principals_flagged >= 1
| fields finding_class, principals_flagged

xql_queries.name: CSPM-001 EBS Encryption and CloudTrail Logging Gaps Surfaced
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and resource_type in ("aws_ebs_volume", "aws_cloudtrail")
| filter tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding"
| filter finding_class in ("ebs-unencrypted", "cloudtrail-weak-config")
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as resources_flagged by finding_class
| filter resources_flagged >= 1
| fields finding_class, resources_flagged

xql_queries.name: CSPM-001 Total Planted-Finding Coverage Reconciliation
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS"
| filter tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding"
| filter finding_class in ("public-read-bucket", "versioning-disabled", "no-customer-managed-kms", "ssh-open-to-world", "database-port-open-to-world", "role-with-admin-access", "user-with-wildcard-iam", "ebs-unencrypted", "cloudtrail-weak-config")
| comp count_distinct(finding_class) as distinct_findings
| filter distinct_findings >= 9
| fields distinct_findings

correlation_rules.name: Cloud Posture Coverage — Full Planted-Misconfiguration Discovery
correlation_rules.logic: XQL(CSPM-001 S3 Data-Exposure Findings Surfaced) AND XQL(CSPM-001 Network-Exposure Security-Group Findings Surfaced) AND XQL(CSPM-001 IAM Over-Permission Findings Surfaced) AND XQL(CSPM-001 EBS Encryption and CloudTrail Logging Gaps Surfaced) AND XQL(CSPM-001 Total Planted-Finding Coverage Reconciliation)

correlation_rules.name: Cloud Posture-to-Runtime — Flagged Exposure Actively Reached or Abused
correlation_rules.logic: BIOC(Inbound Connection Accepted on World-Open SSH/DB Security Group) OR BIOC(Over-Privileged CSPM IAM Principal Used for Control-Plane Action) — promotes a static CSPM finding to an active incident when the flagged misconfiguration is exercised within the POV window.

analytics_modules: Cortex Cloud CSPM — misconfiguration discovery and compliance scoring (CIS AWS Foundations / AWS FSBP)
Cortex Cloud Posture — planted-finding coverage reconciliation
Cortex XSIAM Analytics — anomalous public-source ingress to newly-exposed cloud service

products.evidence_query: dataset = cortex_cloud_posture | filter tags contains "CortexSimCSPMFinding" | comp count_distinct(resource_id) by finding_class | fields finding_class, resource_id
Prisma Cloud Compliance dashboard — CIS AWS Foundations failed checks filtered to CortexSim-tagged resources.

Correlation CR-CSPM-0001 fuses the five per-class posture validation queries into a single cloud-posture coverage event; CR-CSPM-0002 promotes a flagged exposure to an incident when reached/abused at runtime.

use_cases.name: Cloud Security Posture Management — Misconfiguration Detection & Compliance
use_cases.description: Cortex Cloud CSPM discovers and classifies every planted AWS misconfiguration in a single scan cycle and reconciles the finding set against the planted manifest for full coverage; runtime exploitation of a flagged exposure escalates to an incident.

test_cases.objective: Every planted misconfiguration surfaces as a Cortex Cloud CSPM finding within one scan cycle and reconciles to 9/9 coverage.
preconditions: Cortex Cloud CSPM connected (read-only) to the AWS account.
cspm IaC fixture applied (nine CortexSimCSPMFinding-tagged resources).
steps: Observe the CSPM findings list in Cortex Cloud filtered to CortexSimCSPMFinding.
success_criteria: S3 data-exposure query returns >= 3 finding classes.
Network-exposure SG query returns >= 2 finding classes.
IAM over-permission query returns >= 2 finding classes.
Correlation CR-CSPM-0001 raises a cloud-posture coverage event.

test_cases.objective: A flagged static exposure exercised at runtime promotes to an active incident (CSPM-to-runtime stitch).
preconditions: At least one world-open SG or the over-privileged IAM principal is reachable/usable in the lab.
steps: Reach the SSH/DB security group from a public source, or use the AdministratorAccess role / iam:* user for a control-plane action.
Observe the runtime BIOC fire and CR-CSPM-0002 escalate.
success_criteria: BIOC `Inbound Connection Accepted on World-Open SSH/DB Security Group` OR BIOC `Over-Privileged CSPM IAM Principal Used for Control-Plane Action` fires.
Correlation CR-CSPM-0002 raises a posture-to-runtime incident referencing the flagged resource.

preventive_controls: Enforce S3 Block Public Access at the account level; require SSE-KMS and versioning via SCP / org policy.
Prohibit 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on SSH and database ports through preventive guardrails (SCP / Prisma Cloud policy).
Forbid attaching AdministratorAccess and inline iam:* wildcard policies; require least-privilege roles reviewed by IAM Access Analyzer.
Mandate EBS encryption-by-default and a multi-region CloudTrail with log-file validation enabled.
detection_engineering: Alert on any new resource carrying a CSPM finding class without an exception ticket.
Reconcile discovered findings against the approved baseline on every scan cycle.
Stitch static posture findings to runtime telemetry (VPC Flow + CloudTrail) so an exercised exposure escalates.
